title: Boot defaults (noc_enabled=true / overlay_on=false in main) unpinned — the unit pin asserts the test helper's own assignment, not main()'s
evidence:
app/main.odin:296-297:
	app.overlay_on = false
	app.noc_enabled = true

app/noc_toggle_test.odin:24-27:
noc_default_app :: proc() -> (app: App) {
	app.noc_enabled = true // the boot default (main sets it before start_run)
	return
}
detail: No durable test drives main()'s boot assignment; the pin asserts the helper's own value. Deleting `app.noc_enabled = true` ships the feature dead (D inert, row shows OFF) with a green suite — the D-lesson launch-path trap class this diff itself cites.
recommended_fix: Factor boot defaults into a testable proc (e.g. app_defaults()) the suite asserts, or add a CI leg running PP_NOC_E2E=1 on the plain build so the real boot default is continuously proven.

title: No boundary pin for disabling NOC while the panel is open (overlay_on=true + noc_enabled=false leaves the panel drawn with D inert)
detail: The settings case flips only noc_enabled; the draw gate checks only overlay_on. Revoking availability while the panel is visible strands it on-screen with D inert. No test pins whether disable must force-close the panel or leave it.
recommended_fix: Decide the contract: either set overlay_on=false in the SETTINGS_ROW_NOC case, or keep the current behavior; add a mutation-proven leg to app/noc_toggle_test.odin pinning the choice.

title: SETTINGS_ROW_COUNT 4->5 unpinned — no test reaches the NOC row through the real nav/click path; reverting the constant silently unships the row
detail: Nav wrap, row hit-test, panel height, and the draw loop all key off SETTINGS_ROW_COUNT, but the new tests address SETTINGS_ROW_NOC by constant directly. A revert to 4 keeps the suite green while the row becomes unreachable and invisible.
recommended_fix: Add an input-layer leg: open the panel, drive Settings_Navigate deltas to row 4 (or a synthetic click on settings_row_rect(4)), activate, and assert the adjust hook fires with SETTINGS_ROW_NOC.

title: NOC-row presentation beyond the pure label helper unpinned (value_chip_color case + draw_hud snapshot wiring) — matches the other rows' convention
detail: settings_row_label is pinned via a hand-built snapshot; the app->snapshot wiring line and the chip-color case have no test. Deleting either renders a stale OFF/ink row while the feature works. Same convention as the four pre-existing rows.
recommended_fix: Optional: factor the Settings_Snapshot construction out of draw_hud into a pure proc and pin it; the chip color can stay unpinned (cosmetic, consistent with existing rows).

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100% (effect happy+negative unit pins, input-chain pin, e2e pixel proof 0.0% OFF / 98.5% ON, 48/48 goldens byte-identical, replay equal). P1 ~85%: flag effect, row wiring, label, non-persistence pinned; boot default, row reachability, disable-while-visible boundary unpinned. Overall >=80%.
recommended_fix: Add the three missing pins (boot-default assertion, nav/click reachability of row 4, disable-while-visible boundary leg) to raise P1 to >=90% for PASS.
